generationPromptZh: 一个带收腰琴身、连续琴颈和棱线琴头的吉他。它由收腰琴身、上方琴颈和顶端琴头组成。颈宽约为身宽的0.25倍，正面音孔通向琴身内部。宽深比约3.20，高/最大水平跨度约1.44；琴颈从收腰琴身中部向上延伸，颈身重叠与身高比0.25。实测采用3种不透明颜色，琴身以棕色为主，琴颈呈浅棕色。正视看前侧轮廓，侧视看纵深及附件连接，俯视看水平排列和间距；斜视同时显示前面、右侧与顶部，孔隙与接合均来自实体几何。 采用彩色体素。坐标为0至47的整数，X左右、Y向上、Z前后；实际接地最低Y为0。占用750至1250个唯一体素，RGB为0至255整数；保持单一六邻域连通、真实开口及面连接。不要添加展示底板、文字、背景、噪声或悬浮装饰。 原始参数规格：{"baseWidthFraction": 0.55, "category": "guitar", "changedAttributes": ["width", "depth", "height", "supportInset", "shapeChamfer", "featureCount"], "construction": "original continuous boxes and chamfered cross sections", "depth": 6.0, "detailPosition": 0.25, "featureCount": 2, "height": 18.0, "instance": 0, "lipOverhang": 0.6, "neckFraction": 0.42, "ordinal": 60951, "redesign": 0, "rimHeight": 2.0, "shapeChamfer": 0.0, "shoulderFraction": 0.58, "structureIndex": 0, "style": 0, "supportInset": 1.0, "variant": 1, "wallThickness": 2.0, "width": 16.0}
generationPromptEn: An angular guitar with a waisted body, connected neck and edged headstock. It includes a waisted body, upper neck and terminal headstock. The neck is 0.25 body-widths wide; a front soundhole opens inward. Width/depth is 3.20; height/horizontal-span is 1.44. The neck rises centrally above the body. Neck/body-overlap/height is 0.25. Across 3 opaque colors, the body is mainly brown and the neck is tan. Front and side views expose contours and attachment joins; top and oblique views reveal spacing and upper surfaces. Use colored voxels at unique integer coordinates from 0 through 47, with X left to right, Y upward and Z front to back. Real ground contact starts at Y zero. Use 750 through 1250 occupied voxels and integer RGB values from 0 through 255. Keep one six neighbor component, real openings and face connected parts. Add no display base, text, background, noise or floating ornaments.
